subject.title: fix(signal): preserve newlines in debounced messages

question: Should this Signal debounce formatting fix require a redacted after-fix bridge/runtime transcript before merge, or is the focused regression coverage sufficient for this protected PR?
rationale: The patch is mechanically small and the focused assertions cover both agent and command bodies, but the visible PR evidence expressly excludes a live Signal send/receive check and the protected label prevents automated resolution.

options.title: Require Signal runtime proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted post-fix bridge log, terminal capture, or receive transcript proving two debounced Signal messages reach the agent as distinct lines.

options.title: Accept focused test proof
options.body: A Signal-area owner may merge based on the narrow separator correction and focused regression coverage if live-account access is not proportionate to the risk.

recommendation.title: Require Signal runtime proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted post-fix bridge log, terminal capture, or receive transcript proving two debounced Signal messages reach the agent as distinct lines.
